title: Bow and Crossbow Visual Changes
description: Let the bow shoot resemble a crossbow in first person view or vice versa. Compatible with other resource packs that are not occupying corresponding item models.
body:
🏹Introduction
-
Let the bow shoot resemble a crossbow in first person view or vice versa.  
Can be used with other resource packs that are not occupying corresponding item models.  

There are 2 split packs can be used in combination or individually with early versions support：
-  [[1.8+]Horizontal Bow](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/horizontal-bow)
-  [[1.14+]Vertical Crossbow](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/vertical-crossbow)

Horizontal Bow pack in 1.8 may looks a bit different than other versions due to legacy model format.

让弓箭射击在第一人称视角下类似于弩，反之亦然。 
可以与其他不占用相应物品模型的资源包一起使用。 

这些拆分资源包可以组合使用或单独使用：
- 横开弓（[Horizontal Bow](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/horizontal-bow)）
- 纵张弩（[Vertical Crossbow](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/vertical-crossbow)）

由于旧版模型格式，1.8 版本中的资源包表现可能看起来与其他版本的略有不同。
